question.prompt: Cagney can frost a cupcake every \(20\) seconds and Lacey can frost a cupcake every \(30\) seconds. Working together, how many cupcakes can they frost in \(5\) minutes?

solutions.explanation:
Both people work for the full \(5\) minutes, which is \(5\cdot60=300\) seconds. Divide this time by each person's time per cupcake: Cagney frosts \(300\div20=15\) cupcakes, and Lacey frosts \(300\div30=10\). Adding their contributions gives
\[
15+10=\boxed{25}
\]
cupcakes, choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
solutions.title: Add their individual totals
